name: Shawn Johnson
current_role: Attorney; former Casper City Council member and vice mayor
bio: Shawn Johnson is the Libertarian nominee for Wyoming's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026. He served 21 years as an Army combat medic in the Wyoming National Guard, including a 2003-2004 Iraq deployment, then 13 years with the Natrona County Sheriff's Office. He sat on the Casper City Council from 2014 to 2022, including a year as vice mayor, chaired the Libertarian Party of Wyoming, and now practices family law and criminal defense.

platform.point: Says he questioned unnecessary regulation and government spending during eight years on the Casper City Council.
Wants people free to own property, run businesses, defend themselves and make personal choices without needless government interference.
Says public officials must be careful with taxpayer money and accountable for their decisions.
As an Iraq veteran, says sending Americans into harm's way should be a last resort.
Says Wyoming's current delegation has handed too much legislative power to the executive branch.
Pitches himself as an independent voice willing to vote against bad ideas regardless of which party proposes them.
As state Libertarian chair, helped launch a Wyoming medical cannabis ballot initiative.

economy.evidence: General statement: his campaign site says he questioned unnecessary regulation and government spending and stresses care with taxpayer money.

liberty.evidence: Helped launch a medical cannabis initiative as state party chair (drugs), and his site generally backs self-defense (guns) and personal choice free of government interference.

foreign.evidence: General statement: his campaign site says sending Americans into harm's way should be a last resort, citing his Iraq service.
